text.p: Meadowbrook Insurance Group Inc said it completed the acquisition of Association Self Insurance Services Inc (ASI) of Montgomery, Ala.
ASI provides third party administration services to self-insurance trusts including one of the largest in Alabama.
"This acquisition opens up significant opportunities to expand existing and future Alabama business," Merton Segal, chairman, said in a statement.
Meadowbrook will be combining its existing Montgomery office with the ASI operations.
ASI had fee-based revenues of $5.2 million for their most recent September 30, 1996 fiscal year end.
Earlier, Meadowbrook reported third quarter earnings of $0.05 a share, down from $0.38 a share on a pro forma basis.
The decrease in earnings for the quarter was almost entirely the result of higher than anticipated losses in a discontinued portion of the company's surety bond book of business, Meadowbrook said.
The unprofitable surety results were produced by agents who have been terminated by the company, it added.
The company experienced both high claims frequency and severity in the quarter, generating pretax losses of approximately $3.3 million as compared to budgeted profits of $1.1 million.
The company said its portfolio totaled $154 million on September 30, up from $149 million on December 31, 1996.
